smithery.canonical:
# npm-package/smithery.yaml
name: "<<brief-J: verified elsewhere (version_equal/legibility/endpoint_equal) — excluded from this hash>>"
description: "<<brief-J: verified elsewhere (version_equal/legibility/endpoint_equal) — excluded from this hash>>"
startCommand:
  type: stdio
  configSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      novadaApiKey:
        type: string
        description: "Your Novada API key from https://www.novada.com"
    required:
      - novadaApiKey
  commandFunction: |
    config => ({ command: 'npx', args: ['-y', 'novada-mcp'], env: { NOVADA_API_KEY: config.novadaApiKey } })
tools:
  - name: novada_search
    description: "Search the web and get clean, ready-to-use content. Returns titles, URLs, snippets — reranked by relevance. Engines: google (default), duckduckgo, yandex."
  - name: novada_extract
    description: "Extract content from any URL. Handles Cloudflare, DataDome, Kasada automatically via auto-escalation (static → JS render → Browser CDP)."
  - name: novada_crawl
    description: "Use when you need content from a bounded set of pages (up to 20) and don't have the URLs yet. Crawls BFS or DFS, extracts content from each page inline."
  - name: novada_research
    description: "One call → 3-10 parallel searches across Google/Bing/DuckDuckGo → dedup → extract full content from top sources → returns CITED SOURCE MATERIAL (numbered source sections), not a written answer. Extractive, not generative: it gathers and ranks the most relevant passages; YOU compose the final answer from them."
  - name: novada_map
    description: "Use when you need to know what URLs exist on a site before deciding what to read. Tries sitemap.xml first (fast), falls back to BFS crawl."
  - name: novada_site_copy
    description: "Copy an entire docs site or site section to disk as clean markdown — one .md file per page — and return a COMPACT manifest, not the page bodies. Use when you need a whole knowledge base on disk (offline docs ingest, RAG corpus, full-site mirror)."
  - name: novada_scrape
    description: "Use when you need structured data from a specific platform — not raw HTML, but clean tabular records. Supports structured scraping across Amazon, Walmart, Google (incl. Shopping), Bing, DuckDuckGo, Yandex, X/Twitter, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, GitHub, and Perplexity — see the novada://scraper-platforms resource for the always-current list and operation counts."
  - name: novada_scrape_amazon
    description: "Extract structured Amazon data — product details, reviews, seller info, bestseller lists, and category/brand listings — through an Amazon-only tool with a closed, typed `operation` enum. Same underlying engine as novada_scrape, pinned to platform=\"amazon.com\"."
  - name: novada_scrape_google
    description: "Extract structured Google SERP data — organic web search results, AI Mode answers, Maps place/review details, Shopping listings, Jobs, Hotels, and Videos — through a Google-only tool with a closed, typed `operation` enum. Same underlying engine as novada_scrape, pinned to platform=\"google.com\"."
  - name: novada_scrape_bing
    description: "Extract structured Bing SERP data — organic web search results, video results, news results, and shopping listings — through a Bing-only tool with a closed, typed `operation` enum. Same underlying engine as novada_scrape, pinned to platform=\"bing.com\"."
  - name: novada_scrape_duckduckgo
    description: "Extract structured DuckDuckGo web search SERP data through a DuckDuckGo-only tool with a closed, typed `operation` enum. Same underlying engine as novada_scrape, pinned to platform=\"duckduckgo.com\"."
  - name: novada_scrape_yandex
    description: "Extract structured Yandex web search SERP data through a Yandex-only tool with a closed, typed `operation` enum. Same underlying engine as novada_scrape, pinned to platform=\"yandex.com\"."
  - name: novada_scrape_youtube
    description: "Extract structured YouTube data — video and channel metadata, transcripts, comments, and downloadable video/audio files — through a YouTube-only tool with a closed, typed `operation` enum. Same underlying engine as novada_scrape, pinned to platform=\"youtube.com\"."
  - name: novada_scrape_instagram
    description: "Extract structured Instagram data — profiles, posts, reels, and comments — through an Instagram-only tool with a closed, typed `operation` enum. Same underlying engine as novada_scrape, pinned to platform=\"instagram.com\"."
  - name: novada_scrape_facebook
    description: "Extract structured Facebook data — public profile pages, posts, comments, and events — through a Facebook-only tool with a closed, typed `operation` enum. Same underlying engine as novada_scrape, pinned to platform=\"facebook.com\"."
  - name: novada_scrape_tiktok
    description: "Extract structured TikTok data — profile info, post/video details, and post lists by profile, hashtag, or search URL — through a TikTok-only tool with a closed, typed `operation` enum. Same underlying engine as novada_scrape, pinned to platform=\"tiktok.com\"."
  - name: novada_scrape_x
    description: "Extract structured X (Twitter) data — a single post and profile lookups by username or URL — through an X-only tool with a closed, typed `operation` enum. Same underlying engine as novada_scrape, pinned to platform=\"x.com\"."
  - name: novada_scrape_walmart
    description: "Extract structured Walmart data — product details by keyword search, category URL, SKU, zip-code-specific pricing, or direct product URL — through a Walmart-only tool with a closed, typed `operation` enum. Same underlying engine as novada_scrape, pinned to platform=\"walmart.com\"."
  - name: novada_scrape_linkedin
    description: "Extract structured LinkedIn data — job listings (by location/filters, by a jobs search-results URL, or a single job posting URL) and company profile info by URL — through a LinkedIn-only tool with a closed, typed `operation` enum. Same underlying engine as novada_scrape, pinned to platform=\"linkedin.com\"."
  - name: novada_scrape_github
    description: "Extract structured GitHub repository data — repository details by URL, or multiple repositories from a GitHub search-results URL — through a GitHub-only tool with a closed, typed `operation` enum. Same underlying engine as novada_scrape, pinned to platform=\"github.com\"."
  - name: novada_scrape_perplexity
    description: "Extract the actual AI-generated answer Perplexity returns for a query — by a Perplexity query URL or a raw search term — through a Perplexity-only tool with a closed, typed `operation` enum. Same underlying engine as novada_scrape, pinned to platform=\"perplexity.ai\"."
  - name: novada_proxy
    description: "Use when you need to route your own HTTP requests through residential or mobile IPs — for geo-targeting, IP rotation, or bypassing IP-based rate limits. Returns proxy URL, shell export commands, or curl --proxy flag."
  - name: novada_verify
    description: "Use when you have a factual claim and need to check if it's supported by web sources. Runs 3 parallel searches (supporting, skeptical, fact-check angles) and returns a verdict: supported / unsupported / contested / insufficient_data."
  - name: novada_browser
    description: "Use when you need to interact with a web page — click buttons, fill forms, scroll, take screenshots, or execute JavaScript. Chain multiple actions in one call for efficiency."
  - name: novada_browser_flow
    description: "Simplified browser automation with a 5-action flow API (click, scroll, wait, type, screenshot). Use only if you specifically need this simplified flow interface or novada_browser is unavailable."
  - name: novada_ai_monitor
    description: "Search PUBLIC indexed pages on AI-company domains for brand mentions and sentiment — this is NOT page-change monitoring (that's novada_monitor) and does NOT query live AI models."
  - name: novada_monitor
    description: "Detect changes on a web page over time. Extracts content, computes a hash, compares with previous check."
  - name: novada_discover
    description: "List all available Novada tools with name, description, category, and status."
  - name: novada_setup
    description: "The onboarding concierge and first-run front door of the Novada MCP. Call this FIRST when starting out, or whenever a tool reports a missing/invalid key."
  - name: novada_account
    description: "Single-call account & billing dashboard. Composes wallet balance, plan balances, capture logs, and health entitlements based on the `section` param."
  - name: novada_proxy_account_create
    description: "⚠️ WRITE — Create a proxy sub-account. Two-step confirm gate."
  - name: novada_proxy_account_list
    description: "List proxy sub-accounts. Wraps developer-api POST /v1/proxy_account/list."
  - name: novada_ip_whitelist
    description: "Manage IP whitelist for proxy products. Supports add/list/delete/remark for Residential (1), Unlimited (4), and Static ISP (5) products."
  - name: novada_capture_apikey
    description: "Get or reset the Capture API key for the account. Wraps POST /v1/capture/get_apikey and /v1/capture/reset_apikey."
  - name: novada_static_ip_mgmt
    description: "Manage static ISP IPs on the account. Wraps /v1/static_house/* developer-api endpoints."
  - name: novada_session_stats
    description: "Return per-process / per-session usage telemetry: tool-call counts, the last-N calls, and process uptime."
  - name: novada_search_feedback
    description: "Record search-result quality so future ranking can learn from it. Returns a thank-you/echo confirmation with an agent_instruction."

dify-plugin.canonical:
# distribution/dify/manifest.yaml
version: 0.1.0
type: plugin
author: novadalabs
name: novada
label:
  en_US: Novada
  zh_Hans: Novada 网页数据
description:
  en_US: >-
    Search, extract, crawl, and scrape the live web — one API key, powered by
    the Novada hosted MCP server (mcp.novada.com).
  zh_Hans: >-
    一个 API Key 即可搜索、抓取网页与结构化数据 —— 由 Novada 托管 MCP 服务驱动。
created_at: "2026-10-18T18:38:34Z"
# Bare filename, not "_assets/icon.svg" — confirmed by running the official
# `dify plugin init` scaffold: it writes _assets/icon.svg to disk but
# manifest.yaml/provider yaml both reference it as icon: icon.svg (Dify resolves
# icon/icon_dark by basename inside _assets/, not by the manifest-relative path).
icon: icon.svg

resource:
  memory: 268435456 # 256MB — network-bound tool calls, no local model/heavy compute
  permission:
    tool:
      enabled: false
    model:
      enabled: false
    endpoint:
      enabled: false
    app:
      enabled: false
    storage:
      enabled: false
      # Required even when disabled: the packaging CLI's Go struct validates this
      # with a floor of 1024 bytes regardless of `enabled`; omitting it yields a
      # zero-value that fails that minimum (found via `dify plugin package`, exit
      # 1: "Permission.Storage.Size ... failed on the 'min' tag"). Value is the
      # dify_plugin Python SDK's own documented default (1 MiB) for parity.
      size: 1048576

network:
  domains:
    - mcp.novada.com

plugins:
  tools:
    - provider/novada.yaml

meta:
  version: 0.1.0
  arch:
    - amd64
    - arm64
  runner:
    language: python
    version: "3.12"
    entrypoint: main

tags:
  - search
  - utilities

privacy: PRIVACY.md
# Required by the Marketplace local validator (dify-marketplace-toolkit), not by the
# base dify_plugin manifest schema — found via `validate-difypkg.py` run #1.
repo: https://github.com/NovadaLabs/Novada-mcp/tree/main/distribution/dify
contact: support@novada.com
